resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts uses the Fremont National Forest; the Forest Service research page names the Fremont-Winema National Forest. This reads as a later name for the same forest, not a different unit.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the entire lookout history is one line on Forest Lookouts (c.1944). No staffing dates, photos or fate are sourced. The brief's agency 'Fremont National Forest' is the older name, recorded under resolved_conflicts rather than corrections. The RNA page does not say whether the protected area covers the summit, so the story does not link them. A search summary gave a TopoQuest elevation of 5,734 ft; that page was not read and the figure is not used. A search also surfaced Goodnow Mountain, a different peak named in a search result; it was ignored. Fact-check 2026-10-21 re-read the full Forest Lookouts entry, which is three lines with no tower or cabin mentioned.
